item.title: PM assures full support to Sindh for early completion of projects
item.description: F.P. Report ISLAMABAD: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif has said the Federal Government will extend all possible cooperation for the early completion of the ongoing development projects in Sindh. item.title: Punjab approves Rs1.14b for purchase of new vehicles for bureaucrats
item.description: F.P. Report LAHORE: The government of Punjab has decided to purchase 108 new vehicles worth Rs1.14 billion for ministers, senior bureaucrats and official inspection teams during the current fiscal year. item.title: President Zardari approves March 2 joint sitting of Parliament
item.description: F.P. Report ISLAMABAD: President Asif Ali Zardari has approved a summary to convene a joint sitting of Parliament on March 2, marking the formal commencement of the new parliamentary year. The joint session will be held at 3pm on March 2, 2026, in accordance with constitutional requirements that mandate a presidential address at the start […]

item.title: Germany takes delivery of Israeli-made underwater drone
item.description: BERLIN (AFP): The German navy on Wednesday said it had taken delivery of an Israeli-made Blue Whale underwater drone intended for reconnaissance and detecting “hybrid threats at sea.” The autonomous underwater vehicle, developed by Israeli company IAI together with German submarine- and warship-maker TKMS, was received in the northern port of Eckernfoerde, the navy said […]

item.title: North Korea’s Kim says could ‘get along’ with US but shuns South
item.description: SEOUL (AFP) : Kim Jong Un said North Korea could “get along well” with the United States if Washington acknowledges its nuclear status, but dashed hopes of a diplomatic thaw with Seoul, state media reported Thursday. Speculation is mounting that US President Donald Trump may seek a meeting with Kim when he travels to China […]

item.title: UK Labour party threatened by hard-right, leftists in heartland
item.description: MANCHESTER (AFP) : Britain’s ruling Labour party faces a crunch poll on Thursday that is expected to showcase growing support for the hard-right and leftists as the country’s traditional two-party system fractures. Defeat for the government in the parliamentary by-election would add to the woes facing unpopular Prime Minister Keir Starmer who endures frequent mutterings […]

item.description: WASHINGTON : At least 10 FBI employees connected to an investigation of Donald Trump have reportedly been dismissed following revelations that the agency subpoenaed personal records of current FBI director Kash Patel and White House chief of staff Susie Wiles in the years before Trump returned to office. item.title: Explosions rock Ukrainian capital ahead of planned talks in Geneva
item.description: KYIV (AFP) : Several explosions shook central Kyiv early Thursday, AFP journalists heard, after officials warned of air raids in the Ukrainian capital ahead of planned talks in Geneva with US representatives on ending the Russian war.
